title: Commercial sign-in / sign-up

email.description: valid email;max254;normalize domain not provider-specific aliases. Used by the configured identity provider

password.description: configured identity-provider policy;max1024 bytes;allow Unicode and password managers. Never log or persist in app state

terms_version.description: server-supplied approved document ID;required on signup. Version accepted is stored as evidence

accept_terms.description: required true for signup only. Does not authorize trading

return_route.description: server route-key allowlist only. No external redirect accepted

description: Ready-input schema plus server business validation. Draft input uses identical property types but permits missing required fields; missingness must be displayed. Identity/password forms never saved as drafts.
